label: main season
summary: E1 is an unchecked database record of a past accident inside the area (indirect evidence, reliability class 6). Under the national criteria, this record is a clearance target after the first visit, and technical survey is unavailable. E2 provides no information about earlier land use; E3 confirms the team could not see the interior. Cancellation is therefore unsupported, and the rule check passes clearance.
flags: The survey team reached only the edge because rain closed the trail; the interior was not observed.
E1's date and location have not been verified on the ground.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: The record's date, location accuracy and reliability are unverified, so it is weaker indirect evidence; national criteria nevertheless treat this inside-area accident record as a clearance target after the first visit.

E2.quote: The people at the community meeting had moved to the vereda in the last 4 years and could not say how the area was used before.
E2.note: These participants report no knowledge of prior land use and provide neither evidence of contamination nor evidence of safe use over time.

E3.quote: The survey team could reach only the edge of the area, because rain had closed the trail into it, and could not see the land inside.
E3.note: The team did not observe the land inside the area, so this documents a survey limitation rather than evidence for or against EO there.
